description: Operating evidence for due diligence: ad/analytics tags, active job board and Google Ads, each found/not_found/unknown. No financial estimates. $0.03 only when 2 of 3 checks have data. get_company_profile adds contacts and breakout_summary; b2b_vendor_stability_evaluator assesses procurement risk.

context.description: Optional. A few words on why you are calling this tool. Recorded without your identity to improve the tools; leave out personal data.

domain.description: Public company domain without a URL scheme, path or port.

name: company_footprint_check

age_seconds.description: Seconds since checked_at, not the cache insertion time; null when the observation time is unknown.

breakout_summary.description: get_company_profile only. Growth estimate from public signals (hiring, Google Ads, site maturity); not investment advice.

contacts.description: get_company_profile only. Same fields as extract_company_contacts.

footprint.description: found, not_found or unknown for each public signal.

recommended_next_step.description: null after a completed company-profile; no automatic repeat of the same lookup is recommended.

served_from_cache.description: True when the gateway reused a saved result; false does not guarantee the upstream fetched fresh data.

status.description: Only ok is charged: at least two sections have data (of four for get_company_profile, three for company_footprint_check).

title: Company Footprint Check
